questions.text: How long have you been experiencing night sweats, and how severe are they — do they drench your clothes or bedding?
questions.purpose: Characterise duration and severity of night sweats; drenching sweats are a B-symptom of lymphoma

questions.text: Have you also experienced unexplained weight loss or persistent fever alongside the night sweats?
questions.purpose: Identify the classic B-symptom triad: fever, drenching night sweats, and weight loss pointing to lymphoma

questions.text: Do you have any enlarged, painless lymph nodes in your neck, armpits, or groin?
questions.purpose: Lymphadenopathy with B-symptoms is a hallmark presentation of lymphoma

questions.text: Could there be a non-oncological cause such as menopause, tuberculosis, or current infection?
questions.purpose: Exclude common benign causes of night sweats before escalating oncology workup

questions.text: Have you noticed any new bone pain, particularly in the back, hips, or ribs?
questions.purpose: Bone pain may indicate bone marrow involvement or bony metastases

questions.text: Have you experienced unusual fatigue, pallor, or repeated infections recently?
questions.purpose: Cytopaenia features suggesting bone marrow involvement from haematological malignancy
